_comment: The Gnaw's bible — content-as-data, merged over the defaults in src/dungeon.mts at boot. Change the seed to fork a whole new (still shared) cave; tune growth/rewards/odds to repace the descent. The same seed is the same dungeon for every delver.

hazards.name: a spore-bloom
hazards.blurb: Pale spores hang in the air; each breath stings.

hazards.name: collapsing scree
hazards.blurb: The floor sheds under your weight.

hazards.name: a cold draft
hazards.blurb: Something far below is breathing in.

hazards.name: the singing damp
hazards.blurb: Wet stone hums a note that loosens your grip.

tricksters.name: Coyote's pawprint
tricksters.blurb: Coyote got here first and left less than there should be.

tricksters.name: Coyote's wager
tricksters.blurb: Coyote left a bet scratched in the dust — double or nothing.

tricksters.name: Crow's feather
tricksters.blurb: Crow dropped something bright on the way down.

tricksters.name: Crow's question
tricksters.blurb: Crow scratched a riddle on the wall; understanding it leaves an echo.
